disposition.target: 05 Technical architecture/Recovery Workbench Temporal Workflow and Activity Catalog v1.xlsx
disposition.change: Add DataQualityFreshnessCheck (P3, rwb-case, queue rwb-case) to Workflows, refreshStaleSet to Activities, and its Schedule to Schedules: every 15 minutes in the business window, SKIP, catch-up window, ID data-quality-freshness-<env>.
disposition.note: No catalogued rwb-case workflow does this refresh (catalog md export). Name and schedule come from the RWB-P3-AD019-APP story, section 12.
AC1 and AC2 data lines now use the rwb-source-data contract fake of section 12.8; the note under section 7 no longer says verbatim.
Keys now classed as personal data with handling rule, from Data Classification and Personal Data Inventory v5, Fields (DF-CAS-004, 026, 032).
No edit: section 8 'Covered by' maps each of BR1 to BR12 to AC1-AC6, and section 16 has test cases for those criteria, so no rule is left without a criterion or test.
